prompt: Add a `zero ping` subcommand that just prints "pong" and exits 0. No flags, no network calls.

`zero setup <provider>` only accepts a credential via --api-key-env (an env var name it reads at setup time). Add a --api-key flag so a user can pass the literal key value directly instead of having to export an env var first.
Add a `zero spec list` command that prints every draft/approved/rejected spec across all sessions (id, status, title, cwd), similar in spirit to `zero spec show/approve/reject`.
`zero exec -o json` emits prompt_tokens/completion_tokens usage events but no dollar cost. Add an estimated USD cost field to those usage events, using a static per-model price table.
Add a --max-cost <usd> flag to `zero exec` that aborts the run once cumulative token cost for that run crosses the given threshold, instead of running until --max-turns.

When a configured provider's API key is invalid or expired, the current error is a generic auth failure. Improve it so the user immediately knows which provider profile is broken and what to do next (e.g. re-run zero setup with a fresh key).
Some providers return HTTP 429 under load. Add automatic retry with backoff for 429 responses in the provider request path, bounded so it doesn't retry forever.
There's currently no way to cancel a running specialist/swarm member once it's been spawned short of killing the whole zero process. Add a way to cancel a specific in-flight specialist task.
After a spec draft is rejected and redrafted, `zero spec show` only shows the latest version. Add a --diff flag that shows what changed between the rejected draft and the new one.

Add a new AI provider to the catalog for a fictional OpenAI-compatible vendor called "Acme AI" (base URL https://api.acme.ai/v1, default model acme-large, API key env ACME_API_KEY), following the same pattern as existing catalog entries, so it shows up in `zero setup`'s provider list.
